Hi Rajiv — thanks for sending these over and for the note about timelines. Quick read-through from procurement/risk:

- COI: The effective dates look contiguous but we require the additional insured endorsement to name "Redwood Inference, Inc." explicitly on the endorsement page (not just the policy). Can your broker provide an endorsement page or an updated COI that enumerates the additional insured?
- Effective date discrepancy: we can accept continuous coverage if the broker confirms there was no lapse; a broker attestation emailed from their official domain (or a signed letter) is sufficient for now.
- Subcontractor disclosure: for conditional PO we need either (A) an explicit subcontractor list, or (B) a statement that Redwood will be notified before any non-listed subcontractor engagement and that Fast Logistics will obtain matching insurance from subcontractors.

If you can get the endorsement page and broker attestation by EOD Fri (2026-09-03), procurement can issue a conditional PO that will allow onboarding to proceed while final paperwork is queued in our system. If those items are delayed beyond Fri, we'll have to push the PO to the next cycle (anticipated 2-week delay).

I'll loop in Karthik and Marissa to confirm billing and PO terms.

Regards,
Monica Patel
